description: This file is a shell script containing a comprehensive test suite for 'git archive' and related Git functionalities. It sets up repositories, performs various archive operations, verifies metadata like file timestamps, handles different formats and encodings, and tests edge cases involving large files and future timestamps.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Runs a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files.

methods.name: test_cmp_bin
methods.description: Performs binary comparison of two files.

methods.name: test_oid_to_path
methods.description: Converts object ID to file path in .git/objects.

methods.name: test_copy_bytes
methods.description: Copies a specified number of bytes for testing.

methods.name: tar_info
methods.description: Extracts size and year info from tar file listings.
